lead.titleZh: 多模式感觉疗法对脑损伤患者意识改善有积极效应：系统综述
lead.titleEn: Multimodal sensory therapy positively impacts consciousness in brain injury: A systematic review
lead.paragraphZh: 今日共有 17 份条目，其中神经康复领域占主导，有多项关于卒中和脑损伤康复的研究。最值得关注的是一项 curatedScore 达 85 分的系统综述，提示多模式感觉疗法对获得性脑损伤患者意识改善有积极效应。
lead.paragraphEn: Today's 17 entries are dominated by neurological rehabilitation, featuring multiple studies on stroke and brain injury recovery. The most notable is a systematic review, scoring 85, indicating a positive effect of multimodal sensory therapy on consciousness improvement in patients with acquired brain injury.

items.title: Efficacy of a soft robotic exoskeleton for upper-limb rehabilitation in subacute stroke inpatient rehabilitation: a randomised controlled trial
items.summary: This randomized controlled trial investigates the efficacy of a soft robotic exoskeleton for upper-limb rehabilitation in subacute stroke inpatient rehabilitation.
items.curatedReason: 软体机器人外骨骼可能对亚急性卒中住院患者的上肢康复有益，但别急于推广。其长期疗效和成本效益仍需更多RCT证据支持。
items.titleZh: 软体机器人外骨骼对亚急性卒中住院患者上肢康复的疗效：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 这项随机对照试验旨在评估软体机器人外骨骼在亚急性卒中住院患者上肢康复中的疗效。
items.curatedReasonEn: A soft robotic exoskeleton may benefit upper-limb rehabilitation for subacute stroke inpatients, but don't rush to adopt it. More RCTs are needed to confirm its long-term efficacy and cost-effectiveness.
items.limitation: 研究的长期效果和对不同卒中严重程度患者的适用性未详细阐明。
items.limitationEn: The long-term effects of the study and its applicability to patients with different stroke severities were not detailed.

items.title: Non-Biologic Injections in Sports Medicine
items.summary: This review provides an overview of commonly used non-biologic injectates in musculoskeletal care, including corticosteroids, local anesthetics, NSAIDs, normal saline, dextrose prolotherapy, hyaluronic acid, and botulinum toxin, discussing their mechanisms, adverse effects, and clinical evidence in sports medicine.
items.curatedReason: 这篇综述清晰梳理了非生物注射剂在运动医学中的作用。在考虑使用皮质类固醇时，请权衡其短期止痛效果与长期对关节软骨和肌腱的潜在风险。
items.titleZh: 运动医学中的非生物注射剂
items.summaryZh: 本综述概述了肌肉骨骼护理中常用的非生物注射剂，包括皮质类固醇、局部麻醉剂、非甾体抗炎药、生理盐水、葡萄糖增殖疗法、透明质酸和肉毒杆菌毒素，并讨论了它们在运动医学中的作用机制、不良反应和临床证据。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review clearly outlines the role of non-biologic injections in sports medicine. When considering corticosteroids, weigh their short-term analgesic effects against potential long-term risks to articular cartilage and tendons.
items.limitation: 作为一篇综述，其证据级别低于系统综述或RCT，结论可能受限于其所引用研究的质量和偏倚。
items.limitationEn: As a review, its evidence level is lower than a systematic review or RCT, and conclusions may be limited by the quality and bias of the studies cited.

items.title: Educational Videos Were Not Superior to a Folder in Improving Urinary Incontinence Knowledge and Symptoms: A Randomized Controlled Trial
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial found that educational videos were not superior to a simple folder in improving urinary incontinence knowledge and symptoms.
items.curatedReason: 针对尿失禁患者的教育视频在改善知识和症状方面未优于简单的文件夹。这意味着你日常的口头指导和书面材料可能已经足够，无需投入大量资源开发视频内容。
items.titleZh: 教育视频在改善尿失禁知识和症状方面不优于文件夹：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验显示，教育视频在改善尿失禁知识和症状方面，并未优于简单的纸质文件夹。
items.curatedReasonEn: Educational videos for urinary incontinence patients were not superior to simple folders in improving knowledge and symptoms. This implies that your usual verbal instructions and written materials may be sufficient, without the need for significant resources to develop video content.
items.limitation: 研究的随访时间未提及，无法评估长期效果；且患者对信息媒介的偏好可能因文化和个体差异而异。
items.limitationEn: The follow-up duration of the study was not mentioned, preventing evaluation of long-term effects; also, patient preferences for information media may vary due to cultural and individual differences.

items.title: Australian Occupational Health Physiotherapy from 1970-1990: a qualitative study.
items.summary: A qualitative descriptive study explored the development of Australian Occupational Health Physiotherapy from 1970 to 1990, identifying the significance of the Repetitive Strain Injury (RSI) epidemic, ineffective medical responses, barriers in conventional physiotherapy education, and the profession's adaptability.
items.curatedReason: 回顾 1970-1990 年澳大利亚职业健康物理治疗的发展，你会发现 RSI 流行病和随后的立法改革是塑造该专业早期面貌的关键转折点。这篇定性研究提示我们，应对新兴职业健康挑战时，传统教育的局限性与专业适应性同样重要。
items.titleZh: 1970-1990 年澳大利亚职业健康物理治疗：一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究探讨了 1970 至 1990 年间澳大利亚职业健康物理治疗的发展，发现重复性劳损 (RSI) 流行病、医疗反应不足、传统教育障碍以及专业适应性是关键影响因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: Looking back at the 1970-1990 development of Australian Occupational Health Physiotherapy, you'll see the RSI epidemic and subsequent legislative reforms were pivotal in shaping the profession's early landscape. This qualitative study suggests that, when confronting emerging occupational health challenges, the limitations of traditional education and the profession's adaptability are equally critical.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性回顾，结果基于特定时期的少数受访者叙述，可能存在回忆偏倚和样本代表性局限。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative retrospective study's findings are based on narratives from a limited number of interviewees during a specific period, potentially subject to recall bias and sampling limitations.

items.title: Effects of different foot orthoses on muscular frequency spectrum during the swing phase of gait following ACL reconstruction: a cross-sectional, mixed-model within-subject study
items.summary: This cross-sectional study investigates the effects of different foot orthoses on muscular frequency spectrum during the swing phase of gait following ACL reconstruction.
items.curatedReason: ACL 重建术后患者在步态摆动期使用不同足部矫形器，其肌肉频率谱会受到影响。这提示你矫形器可能对术后步态生物力学有微妙改变，但本研究无法提供因果关系。
items.titleZh: ACL 重建术后步态摆动期不同足部矫形器对肌肉频率谱的影响：一项横断面、混合模型受试者内研究
items.summaryZh: 这项横断面研究探讨了前交叉韧带（ACL）重建术后患者在步态摆动期使用不同足部矫形器对肌肉频率谱的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: Foot orthoses affect the muscular frequency spectrum during the swing phase of gait after ACL reconstruction. This suggests orthoses might subtly alter post-surgical gait biomechanics, but this study can't establish causality.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面研究，无法揭示因果关系或长期效果，且只关注了肌肉频率谱这一生物力学指标。
items.limitationEn: This is a cross-sectional study, unable to reveal causal relationships or long-term effects, and it only focused on muscle frequency spectrum as a biomechanical indicator.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: The effect of multimodal sensory therapy in consciousness improvement in patients with acquired brain injury: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 18 studies (884 participants) found that multimodal sensory therapy significantly improved consciousness levels (SMD, 1.48; 95% CI, 1.04-1.92) and increased the odds of coma emergence (OR, 9.85; 95% CI, 3.86-25.01) in adults with acquired brain injury-related disorders of consciousness.
items.curatedReason: 对脑损伤意识障碍患者，多模式感觉疗法应成为常规康复方案的一部分。这项高质量系统综述和荟萃分析确证了它能显著改善意识水平（SMD 1.48），并使昏迷苏醒的几率提高近10倍（OR 9.85）。
items.titleZh: 多模式感觉疗法对获得性脑损伤患者意识改善的效应：系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含18项研究（884名参与者）的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，多模式感觉疗法能显著改善获得性脑损伤意识障碍成年患者的意识水平（SMD 1.48）并增加从昏迷中苏醒的几率（OR 9.85）。
items.curatedReasonEn: For patients with acquired brain injury and disorders of consciousness, multimodal sensory therapy should be a standard component of rehabilitation protocols. This high-quality systematic review and meta-analysis confirms it significantly improves consciousness levels (SMD 1.48) and increases the odds of coma emergence by nearly 10-fold (OR 9.85).
items.limitation: 纳入研究的方法学局限性和异质性是主要的限制，可能影响证据的总体强度。
items.limitationEn: Methodological limitations and heterogeneity across included studies are key limitations, potentially affecting the overall strength of the evidence.

items.title: Music-based interventions in adult stroke rehabilitation: a narrative review of clinical applications, proposed mechanisms, and implementation.
items.summary: A narrative review on music-based interventions in adult stroke rehabilitation found consistent evidence for rhythmic auditory stimulation in gait and music-supported upper-limb programs, with potential for melodic intonation therapy in nonfluent aphasia, but highlights inconsistent terminology and overstated mechanisms.
items.curatedReason: 本综述明确了音乐干预在卒中康复中的应用边界和证据强度。对步态障碍应优先考虑节律性听觉刺激（RAS），上肢功能可考虑音乐支持项目，但其他应用证据尚不充分，尤其是需要警惕夸大的机制阐释。
items.titleZh: 成人卒中康复中的音乐干预：临床应用、作用机制和实施的叙述性综述
items.summaryZh: 一项关于成人卒中康复中音乐干预的叙述性综述显示，节律性听觉刺激对步态、音乐辅助上肢训练的证据最一致，旋律语调疗法对非流畅性失语症有潜力，但该领域术语不一且存在夸大机制的问题。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review clarifies the scope and evidence strength of music-based interventions in stroke rehabilitation. Prioritize rhythmic auditory stimulation (RAS) for gait, and consider music-supported programs for upper limb function. Be cautious of overblown claims about mechanisms, as evidence for other applications remains insufficient.
items.limitation: 本综述为叙述性综述，未进行正式的偏倚风险评估和定量汇总，可能存在选择性偏倚。
items.limitationEn: As a narrative review, this study did not conduct formal risk-of-bias assessment or quantitative pooling, which may introduce selection bias.

items.title: Multisensory training with telerehabilitation for brain injured children with visual field defects
items.summary: This research investigates multisensory training with telerehabilitation for brain-injured children with visual field defects.
items.curatedReason: 针对有视野缺损的脑损伤儿童，多感官训练结合远程康复显示出可行性。远程康复增加了服务可及性，但其有效性仍需更强的证据支持。
items.titleZh: 针对有视野缺损的脑损伤儿童的多感官训练结合远程康复
items.summaryZh: 这项研究探讨了对有视野缺损的脑损伤儿童进行多感官训练结合远程康复的效果。
items.curatedReasonEn: Multisensory training with telerehabilitation is feasible for brain-injured children with visual field defects. While telerehabilitation improves accessibility, its efficacy still requires stronger evidence.
items.limitation: 研究设计未明确，样本量未提及，需要进一步的对照研究来验证其有效性。
items.limitationEn: The study design and sample size were not specified, and further controlled studies are needed to validate its effectiveness.

items.title: Stroke survivors' experience using mechanically-assisted devices as a component of their upper limb motor rehabilitation program.
items.summary: A qualitative study with 11 stroke survivors explored their experiences using mechanically-assisted devices for upper limb rehabilitation, revealing themes around intrinsic motivation, device benefits and drawbacks, and the critical influence of people (clinicians) on practice experience.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究强调了卒中患者使用机械辅助装置进行上肢康复时的复杂体验，提示你不仅要关注设备功能，更要重视患者的内在动机、目标导向反馈以及治疗师在设备设置和支持中的关键作用。
items.titleZh: 卒中幸存者使用机械辅助设备进行上肢运动康复项目的体验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对11名卒中幸存者的定性研究探讨了他们使用机械辅助设备进行上肢康复的体验，揭示了内在动机、设备利弊以及医护人员对康复体验的关键影响等主题。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study highlights the complex experiences of stroke survivors using mechanically-assisted devices for upper limb rehabilitation. It reminds you to focus not only on device functionality but also on intrinsic motivation, goal-oriented feedback, and the critical role of the clinician in device setup and support.
items.limitation: 本研究为小样本定性研究，结果的通用性有限，且访谈对象均在卒中后6个月内，可能无法代表所有卒中患者的体验。
items.limitationEn: This is a small-sample qualitative study with limited generalizability, and participants were all within 6 months post-stroke, which may not represent the experiences of all stroke survivors.

items.title: Effects of an actuated ankle exoskeleton on walking stability in healthy adults: a controlled laboratory study
items.summary: This controlled laboratory study investigates the effects of an actuated ankle exoskeleton on walking stability in healthy adults.
items.curatedReason: 动力踝关节外骨骼对健康成人步态稳定性的影响是机器人辅助康复的早期探索。目前研究在健康人群，还需等待其在患者群体的效果证据。
items.titleZh: 动力踝关节外骨骼对健康成人步态稳定性的影响：一项对照实验室研究
items.summaryZh: 这项对照实验室研究探讨了动力踝关节外骨骼对健康成人步态稳定性的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: The effect of an actuated ankle exoskeleton on walking stability in healthy adults is an early exploration in robotic-assisted rehabilitation. Current research focuses on healthy individuals, and evidence of its effects in patient populations is still needed.
items.limitation: 研究对象是健康成人，结果无法直接外推至神经功能受损的患者群体。
items.limitationEn: The study participants were healthy adults, so the results cannot be directly extrapolated to patient populations with neurological impairments.

items.title: Electrical bioimpedance spectral markers distinguish balance ability in older adults without provoking fall risk
items.summary: This research explores electrical bioimpedance spectral markers that distinguish balance ability in older adults without provoking fall risk.
items.curatedReason: 电生物阻抗频谱标志物能区分老年人的平衡能力。它或许是早期识别平衡功能下降患者的一种无跌倒风险的新型评估工具，但尚待大规模验证。
items.titleZh: 电生物阻抗频谱标志物可区分老年人的平衡能力且不引发跌倒风险
items.summaryZh: 这项研究探索了能够区分老年人平衡能力且不引发跌倒风险的电生物阻抗频谱标志物。
items.curatedReasonEn: Electrical bioimpedance spectral markers can distinguish balance ability in older adults. This may be a promising, fall-risk-free assessment tool for early identification of balance decline, but it requires larger-scale validation.
items.limitation: 这项研究是观察性的，无法建立因果关系，也未与金标准平衡评估工具进行对比验证。
items.limitationEn: This observational study cannot establish causality and did not validate findings against gold-standard balance assessment tools.

items.title: Artificial intelligence and wearable technology in athlete load management and injury prediction: a systematic literature review
items.summary: This systematic review analyzes the status of artificial intelligence and wearable devices in athlete load management and injury prediction, aiming to summarize information for functional, physiological, and biomechanical areas.
items.curatedReason: 人工智能和可穿戴技术在运动员负荷管理和伤病预测方面的潜力巨大。但这篇综述本身是方法学综述，提醒你当前该领域的研究还处于早期阶段，实证数据有限。
items.titleZh: 人工智能和可穿戴技术在运动员负荷管理和伤病预测中的应用：一项系统文献综述
items.summaryZh: 这项系统综述分析了人工智能和可穿戴设备在运动员负荷管理和伤病预测中的现状，旨在总结功能、生理和生物力学领域的信息。
items.curatedReasonEn: Artificial intelligence and wearable technology hold immense potential in athlete load management and injury prediction. However, this review is methodological in nature, reminding you that research in this field is still in its early stages with limited empirical data.
items.limitation: 这项系统综述主要侧重于文献分析，缺乏实证数据和临床应用结果的深入探讨。
items.limitationEn: This systematic review primarily focuses on literature analysis, lacking in-depth discussion of empirical data and clinical application results.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Effects of flywheel training on post-activation performance enhancement in male basketball players
items.summary: This exploratory crossover study with 20 collegiate male basketball players examined inertia- and time-specific responses after flywheel half-squat conditioning to understand its effects on post-activation performance enhancement.
items.curatedReason: 飞轮训练对篮球运动员训练后表现增强（PAPE）的影响是运动表现领域的一个研究方向。关注其在特定惯量和时间点上的反应，可能有助于你优化运动员的力量训练方案。
items.titleZh: 飞轮训练对篮球运动员训练后表现增强的影响
items.summaryZh: 这项对 20 名大学男子篮球运动员进行的探索性交叉研究，旨在探讨飞轮半蹲训练后，在特定惯量和时间点上对训练后表现增强的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: The effects of flywheel training on post-activation performance enhancement (PAPE) in basketball players is a research direction in sports performance. Focusing on its responses at specific inertias and time points may help you optimize athletes' strength training programs.
items.limitation: 这是一项探索性交叉研究，样本量较小（20 名运动员），结果的普遍性和长期效果需要进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: This is an exploratory crossover study with a small sample size (20 athletes), so the generalizability and long-term effects of the results require further validation.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Now Available: Resources Offer a Practical Look at How PT Codes Are Valued
items.summary: APTA has released two new resources to help physical therapists, physical therapist assistants, and students understand how payment rates are established and the policies influencing payment for physical therapist services.
items.curatedReason: APTA 发布了关于物理治疗编码定价和支付政策的新资源。如果你在美国执业，务必立即查阅，这直接影响你的报销和实践运营。
items.titleZh: APTA 发布：提供 PT 编码定价实用指南的资源现已上线
items.summaryZh: 美国物理治疗协会 (APTA) 发布了两项新资源，旨在帮助物理治疗师、物理治疗师助理和学生了解物理治疗服务的定价方式及影响支付的政策。
items.curatedReasonEn: APTA has released new resources on physical therapy coding valuation and payment policies. If you practice in the U.S., you must review these immediately, as they directly impact your reimbursement and practice operations.

items.title: Patients’ experiences of participating in physiotherapeutic telerehabilitation for postpartum pelvic floor dysfunction; a qualitative study
items.summary: This qualitative study explores patients’ experiences of participating in physiotherapeutic telerehabilitation for postpartum pelvic floor dysfunction, highlighting the growing access to telerehabilitation but a lack of knowledge on patient experiences.
items.curatedReason: 远程康复为产后盆底功能障碍患者提供了新的选择，但其体验可能复杂。在设计远程服务时，需充分了解患者的真实感受，以提升依从性和满意度。
items.titleZh: 产后盆底功能障碍患者参与物理治疗远程康复的体验：一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 这项定性研究探讨了产后盆底功能障碍患者参与物理治疗远程康复的体验，揭示了远程康复日益普及，但对患者体验的了解仍不足。
items.curatedReasonEn: Telerehabilitation offers a new option for postpartum pelvic floor dysfunction, but patient experiences can be complex. When designing remote services, you need to understand patients' true feelings to improve adherence and satisfaction.
items.limitation: 这项定性研究的发现基于患者的个人主观体验，可能不具普遍性，且未评估干预的临床疗效。
items.limitationEn: The findings of this qualitative study are based on patients' subjective personal experiences, may not be generalizable, and did not assess the clinical efficacy of the intervention.

flashes.title: A reduced sensor configuration for upper extremity monitoring after stroke
flashes.titleZh: 卒中后上肢监测的简化传感器配置

flashes.title: Intensive Home-Based Motor Imagery Neurofeedback Training Using Mobile EEG to Assess Changes in Brain Activity and Motor Function in Stroke Survivors: A Multiple Baseline Design (MINTS Study Protocol)
flashes.titleZh: 使用移动脑电图进行强化居家运动想象神经反馈训练以评估卒中幸存者脑活动和运动功能变化：一项多基线设计（MINTS 研究方案）
